noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

retryable.description: Retry action if failure is a retryable c3 exception such as VersionConflict.

class.description:
The Python class name of the native field type, parameter or return value (as marked with the "native" value type).

```type
numpyToArray: function(np: @py(class="numpy.ndarray") native): [string]
```

sourceVersion.description:
Specific version of the language required for the source code. The supported versions vary by language so for
languages that support multiple versions, this field is overridden with an enumeration. If unspecified, it is
assumed that the source code corresponds to a "base" version which is upward compatible.

redirectTypeDispatchField.description:
Mechanism to redirect the dispatch of the annotated method to a method with the same name and signature (but
may be annotated with a different python runtime) on another Type.  Only applies to member methods (will be
silently ignored if annotated on a static method).
The value of this annotation is the name of a data field on the called instance (`this` object), which holds the
name of the other Type to redirect the dispatch to.  Note that you cannot chain multiple dispatch re-directions
with this mechanism.

This mechanism is a simplified version of the (not yet available) capability to enable calling methods on previous
versions of a Type.

Commented out deprecation annotation below although it is valid, because it's annoying to see deprecation warnings

in the console each time you call an annotated method.

@deprecated(finalVersion="8", details="The capabilities enabled by this field will be replaced by the capability to version Types in V8.")
